correctness.rationale: Renewal gives m_r=(1-phi_r)/(r phi_r(x_star)). Integrating factor yields -p phi_r′=r integral p phi_r/D, so m_r′>0. For y>x the ratio phi_r(y)/phi_r(x)=E_y exp(-r T_x) is strictly decreasing in r, making H_r=r phi_r/(-phi_r′) strictly increasing and W=(m1′m2′/D)(H2-H1)>0. The resetting backward equation is invertible by Cramer′s rule. Interior-supported D perturbation and compensating b prove one-rate failure. Exact argument, checked numerically from the embedded script; no reliance on finite checks for the general proof.

value.rationale: Recovers two freely varying spatial generator coefficients from two controllable mean-passage experiments, with a global nonzero determinant rather than a genericity assumption. A constructive infinite-dimensional counterfamily shows one experiment cannot suffice, making the exact two-rate cutoff physically and mathematically meaningful. The result quantifies transport-model identifiability, not routine substitution or a fixed numerical case.
